key: CHARLOTTE: This metal junk is new.
en: CHARLOTTE: This metal junk is new.
ja: シャルロット: この金属のガラクタ、新しいね。

key: I don't think that's a good sign.
en: I don't think that's a good sign.
ja: いい兆候だとは思えないけど。

key: ANNA: Wh-what was that?
en: ANNA: Wh-what was that?
ja: アンナ: な、何あれ?

key: CHARLOTTE: I don't know.
en: CHARLOTTE: I don't know.
ja: シャルロット: さあね。

key: Let's keep moving.
en: Let's keep moving.
ja: とにかく進もう。

key: CHARLOTTE: Our place is just through here.
en: CHARLOTTE: Our place is just through here.
ja: シャルロット: あたしたちの家は、この先すぐ。

key: The way through this place is pretty discreet if you're not looking for it.
en: The way through this place is pretty discreet if you're not looking for it.
ja: 探してなければ、ここの通り道はかなり目立たない。

key: Makes it a cozy little hideout. Our family's used it for years.
en: Makes it a cozy little hideout. Our family's used it for years.
ja: だから居心地のいい隠れ家になってる。うちの家族はもう何年も使ってるの。

key: Well, I'll go ahead.
en: Well, I'll go ahead.
ja: じゃ、先に行くね。

key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて、壊すことも動かすこともできないようだ……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables.
en: The rock base may hold more valuables.
ja: この岩の土台には、まだ何か価値のあるものが眠っているかもしれない。

key: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: ばくはつのこなで開けますか?

key: GRUNT: So you came.
en: GRUNT: So you came.
ja: メテオ団員: 来たか。

key: GRUNT: We were hoping you'd be dumb enough-- I mean, brave enough.
en: GRUNT: We were hoping you'd be dumb enough-- I mean, brave enough.
ja: メテオ団員: バカ正直に――いや、勇敢に来てくれることを願ってたぜ。

key: GRUNT: And now, you're ours!
en: GRUNT: And now, you're ours!
ja: メテオ団員: これでお前は、オレたちのものだ!

key: DUO: This is an attack.
en: DUO: This is an attack.
ja: デュオ: これは攻撃だ。

key: So brace for impact.
en: So brace for impact.
ja: 覚悟しておけ。

key: To eliminate this infestation!
en: To eliminate this infestation!
ja: この害虫どもを一掃するために!

key: To restore the art of God's own nation!
en: To restore the art of God's own nation!
ja: 神の国の芸術を取り戻すために!

key: To break apart the world above!
en: To break apart the world above!
ja: 地上の世界を打ち砕くために!

key: To find what lies beneath truth and love!
en: To find what lies beneath truth and love!
ja: 真実と愛の下に眠るものを見つけるために!

key: Team Meteor!
en: Team Meteor!
ja: チームメテオ!

key: Resonating with the eternal light!
en: Resonating with the eternal light!
ja: 永遠の光と共鳴する!

key: Run away now, don't try to fight!
en: Run away now, don't try to fight!
ja: 今すぐ逃げろ、戦おうとするな!

key: For justice! That's right!
en: For justice! That's right!
ja: 正義のために! そうだ!

key: GRUNT: Two-on-one, baby!
en: GRUNT: Two-on-one, baby!
ja: メテオ団員: 二対一だぜ、ベイベー!

key: Whaaaat.
en: Whaaaat.
ja: なんだよ。

key: Really, it didn't even make a difference?
en: Really, it didn't even make a difference?
ja: マジかよ、意味なかったのかよ?

key: GRUNT: Urgh... I guess the mountain is still unstable.
en: GRUNT: Urgh... I guess the mountain is still unstable.
ja: メテオ団員: くそ……この山、まだ不安定みたいだな。

key: GRUNT: The commotion we're making can't be helping.
en: GRUNT: The commotion we're making can't be helping.
ja: メテオ団員: オレたちが騒いでるのも、良くないんだろうな。

key: And we still lost. Ridiculous.
en: And we still lost. Ridiculous.
ja: それでも負けるとは。バカげてる。

key: I'm leaving.
en: I'm leaving.
ja: オレは抜けるぞ。

key: I'm done with this nonsense. It's hopeless.
en: I'm done with this nonsense. It's hopeless.
ja: こんなバカげたこと、もうやってられねえ。無理だ。

key: GRUNT: Hey, wait-- Wait up!
en: GRUNT: Hey, wait-- Wait up!
ja: メテオ団員: おい待て――待てって!

key: Solrock seems to be drawn to the PokéSnax.
en: Solrock seems to be drawn to the PokéSnax.
ja: ソルロックが、ポケスナックに引き寄せられているようだ。

key: The hungry Pokémon attacked!
en: The hungry Pokémon attacked!
ja: 空腹のポケモンが攻撃してきた!

key: Lunatone seems to be drawn to the PokéSnax.
en: Lunatone seems to be drawn to the PokéSnax.
ja: ルナトーンが、ポケスナックに引き寄せられているようだ。

key: SAPHIRA: This must be it.
en: SAPHIRA: This must be it.
ja: サファイラ: ここに違いない。

key: Let's go.
en: Let's go.
ja: 行くわよ。

key: SAPHIRA: Dragonite.
en: SAPHIRA: Dragonite.
ja: サファイラ: カイリュー。

key: Tear it down.
en: Tear it down.
ja: 破壊しなさい。

key: LAURA: This is where I saw them before........
en: LAURA: This is where I saw them before........
ja: ローラ: 前にここで見かけたんです……

key: But how do we get through this gate?
en: But how do we get through this gate?
ja: でも、この門はどうやって通ればいいんでしょう?

key: LAURA: Umm........
en: LAURA: Umm........
ja: ローラ: ええと……

key: LAURA: Team Meteor must have some way of opening it, right?
en: LAURA: Team Meteor must have some way of opening it, right?
ja: ローラ: チームメテオには、何かこれを開ける方法があるはずですよね?

key: So maybe there's a switch somewhere........
en: So maybe there's a switch somewhere........
ja: だから、どこかにスイッチがあるのかも……

key: LAURA: Ah!!! O-ow........
en: LAURA: Ah!!! O-ow........
ja: ローラ: きゃっ!!! い、痛い……

key: LAURA: Oh, no, now I'm all dirty........
en: LAURA: Oh, no, now I'm all dirty........
ja: ローラ: ああ、もう、汚れちゃいました……

key: Wait, the gate opened?! There must have been a switch there........ Oops!
en: Wait, the gate opened?! There must have been a switch there........ Oops!
ja: あれ、門が開きました?! きっとそこにスイッチがあったんですね……あら、すみません!
ええと……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
